stations.name: Prodromos Forest College
stations.source: Cyprus Department of Meteorology official daily data
stations.coordinateCaution: Modern AWS coordinate from Cyprus official 2021 network metadata, not proof of identical historic thermometer GPS; published station elevation1380m.
stations.quality: Official source has no daily QC flags; accepted CSV validates dates, plausible values and min<=max, excludes conflicting dates and duplicates, no gapfill or independent homogenization. Same >=95% annual plus November-March completeness as GHCN calibration. 2025 partial year excluded.

validation.scheme: Leave complete geographic regions out; station-balanced. Model selected using these comparisons; not an independent final test.

freeze.scope: Station-calibrated annual freeze-event hazard. Local residual correction shrinks to zero with absent support; centered weather-error distribution remains global. Not a yield-loss probability.

coarse.globalFit: 44primarymatchedperiodstations only; supplemental shortrecords enter localcorrection only

nodes.period: Four fully observed recent winters 2014/2015/2024/2025 versus CHELSA1981-2010. No warming adjustment made.
Only 2-4 eligible complete monthly records in1981-1984, not 30year normals, no independent instrument.

chillValidation.scope: Predictions of modeled daily-station DMA chill-requirement attainment from gridded monthly-normal modeled-CU, not observed flowering, fruit set, harvest reliability, or yield probability.
chillValidation.crossValidation: Leave complete geographic regions out; all cultivar outcomes of a station stay together. Station/cultivar equal weighting. Selection using these folds is not an independent final test.
chillValidation.parameters: Arbequina: optimum7.3, breakpoint21.7, warmRate-0.50, CU339; Leccino/Frantoio: breakpoint20.7, warmRate-0.56, CU612/671.
